notes: Retrieval benchmark queries for retrieval_cards_fixture.json. 'expected' lists acceptable card ids (a hit means ANY of them is in the top-k). oos=true means no card should match well. Hindi here is for testing only and is recorded in app/data/hindi_review/retrieval.md. split=tuned queries were written together with the glossary; split=heldout queries were written after the glossary was frozen and give a more honest estimate. split=heldout2 was written after the glossary was extended using the misses of split=heldout (so heldout is no longer fully blind); heldout2 is the least biased estimate.
